blocks.text: In just its first year, Nova Aesthetics and Wellness Clinic has become a familiar name within the Philippine beauty, pageant, fashion, and entertainment communities. The clinic has supported pageant personalities, candidates, models, ambassadors, and public figures, and has participated in initiatives associated with Miss World Philippines, Mr. World Philippines, Mr. & Miss Chinatown, as well as other industry events. But step inside NOVA, and Dr. Edzel “Zed” Magtoto is clear about one thing: there are no VIPs here. For a clinic with close ties to industries where appearance is often part of the job, Dr. Magtoto never wants someone outside those […]...
